title: myosotis decumbens subsp. teresiana
intro: Myosotis decumbens subsp. teresiana, commonly known as the Tasmanian forget-me-not, is a plant species native to Australia, specifically in the island of Tasmania. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of M. decumbens subsp. teresiana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of the plant, including iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
